name: Dermatology
content:
Your skin is your largest and most exposed organ and, therefore, In the sense of defenseless to injury and damage. At SARAVANA HOSPITAL our Department of Dermatology, Cosmetic Surgery and Hair Transplant offers expert medical, surgical and cosmetic care for all ailments that relate to the skin, nails and hair.

From common skin conditions to life-threatening reactions

The services of the Department of Dermatology, Cosmetic Surgery and Hair Transplant cover common skin conditions such as pimples, hair loss, eczema and allergies, and aesthetic procedures to improve the complexion and rejuvenate the skin, as well as complicated life-threatening blistering disorders and drug reactions.

name: Ophthalmology
content:
The Department of Ophthalmology in SARAVANA HOSPITAL is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure to keep up with the advancement in technology in the evaluation and management of eye problem and blindness. The Department with senior consultants, consultants and associate consultants who are well experienced and are excellent in their professional competence.

Outpatient services include refraction and prescription of spectacles, slit lamp bio microscopic evaluation of the anterior and posterior segment. Routine screening is undertaken for Glaucoma, Diabetic and Hypertensive retinopathy and Retinopathy of Prematurity in premature infants.

Our surgeons have specific training and experience in a broad range of subspecialties such as the

  • Cornea
  • Retina
  • Uvea
  • Glaucoma
  • Squint
  • Neuro-ophthalmology
  • Pediatric ophthalmology
  • Orbit
  • Oculoplasty.

The Department is recognized for its work in patient care, education, and research. Training of both undergraduates and postgraduates comprises of both basic and research programs which focus on academic and surgical components. On a regular basis, training is given to both medical and paramedical students.

name: Medical & Surgical Oncology
content:
At SARAVANA HOSPITAL, our team of medical oncologists, surgical oncologists are highly experienced in diagnosing and treating different types of cancer. We support both the diagnosis and treatment of different types of cancer. We provide personalized care to deliver the best possible outcome.

We provide a multi-disciplinary approach using a combination of medical oncology treatment. Our oncologist carefully monitors the patient during the entire course of the treatment and meets regularly with a multi-disciplinary team of care specialists to review the progress and plan the treatment course.
